purpose.summary: PRINTUTL is a print utility subprogram that abstracts report output across multiple destinations: physical printer (LPT/COM ports), disk spool file, and screen display. Calling programs issue commands (Open, Close, Print, Skip, End-of-report) without needing to know the actual output destination. It handles page length, line advance, expanded/condensed print modes, and left/right screen scrolling for wide reports.
